method: Actual PNG viewed in the independent child context; complete actual submitted sidecar prompt/history and batch source contracts compared with current source template/handlers and matching real baseline where available. No generation or product runtime tests.
selectedState: Owner contextual image tools, two independent top/lower scroll positions, readOnly=false and selected image stable.
fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Actual PNG/full submitted prompt/current image-context template inspected. A heading/helper/alt/title inputs, B preserved title plus apply/preview/replace/delete actions in exact source order, no added URL/size/alignment/cancel/close/save.
Both are scroll positions of same bounded actual tool group, not two simultaneously mounted windows. No discarded hidden field/action; real contextual host/selection/bookmark guards remain.
Actual <=720 context tools max-height min180px/35vh, overflow/focus/readonly behavior must use source CSS. Raster scale is approximate, not measured component height or runtime reachability.

styleFindings.finding: Raster texture/shading and approximate geometry remain illustrative. Use shared flat CSS tokens and source conditional scrolling/focus/disabled behavior; no exact CSS or responsive/runtime compliance claimed.

limitations: Static design review does not prove API execution, permissions, dirty/busy/close guards, focus/keyboard, persistence, canvas topology or responsive fit.
Only declared compatible state reviewed; hidden mutually exclusive branches remain separate mappings. Source-derived examples are not captured runtime results.
Per-image verdict does not complete full-design global consistency/coverage review or authorize product implementation.
